name: Kyoto University
header:
Kyoto University
Japan · Graduate School of Science: Mathematics and Mathematical Sciences master’s (Department / RIMS tracks), then
three-year doctorate
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Department Mathematics and RIMS Mathematical Sciences are distinct tracks; applicants may select both but
need their different questionnaires/reports and possibly separate orals.
• April 2027 admission is already closed and requires degree by March 2027; the next guide must be checked
for October 2027.
• AAO introduces a separate SOP/research-plan stage, before the academic application.
• AFLSP has citizenship and prior-admission restrictions plus a stale linked form; receiving scholarship does not
itself confer admission.
• Tomoyuki Arakawa moved to OIST and became Kyoto professor emeritus in April 2026; do not rely on an
older RIMS listing for 2027 supervision. Official OIST profile
https://www.oist.jp/research/research-units/chiral/tomoyuki-arakawa.
• Faculty listing does not guarantee capacity or acceptance; check supervisor consent and Mathematics versus
RIMS selection before applying.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
UChicago bachelor’s normally qualifies for a master’s if complete before matriculation; a master’s or
equivalent normally precedes the three-year PhD. April 2027 requires degree by 31 March 2027, so June 2027
graduation misses it. October 2027 remains a possible future route requiring next-year instructions, not the
closed booklet’s October 2026 option. [s5] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Complete AAO before the school’s application period; start 2-3 months before the deadline. AAO requires an
account, academic documents and SOP/research plan; it is separate from admission and funding. Identify a
supervisor, await AAO permission where applicable, then contact them. Regular entrance exams require travel
to Kyoto and a suitable visa; US F-1 is insufficient for Japan. [s6] [s7] [s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Complete AAO first where instructed; its contact permission is not admission. RIMS recommends
prospective-supervisor contact before formal application. Math questionnaire can name advisers without an
established acceptance commitment. Confirm October 2027 supervision and exam language before planning
travel.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: The 2027 Mathematics guide lists some assistant professors
among advisers; do not infer ineligibility merely from rank. Program-specific/Hakubi appointments Kakuhama
and Shimada were absent from the checked guide, so independent supervision is unresolved. [s6] [s22] [s3]
[jguide]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
AAO online registration→document upload→submit→confirmation→processing/result email. Formal 2027
admission is postal, with separate online fee/contact form. AFLSP complete PDF/JPEG packet in one ZIP emailed

to AFLSP@mail2.adm.kyoto-u.ac.jp; video provided as accessible link. No accounts created or invitations sent
in this research. [s6] [s2] [s9] [s12]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
The posted 2027 master’s round is closed and addresses April 2027/October 2026. Do not label October 2027
closed; its precise admission guide/deadline is unverified. April 2027 AFLSP is currently open until 13
November 2026, but it cannot reopen closed math admission or waive bachelor’s completion. [s1] [s2] [s9]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Current 2027 booklet: postal receipt 22-26 June 2026, closing 26 June 17:00 (Japan local time inferred), now
closed. It covers April 2027 and exceptional October 2026, not October 2027. Overseas couriers must arrive by
deadline; a narrowly defined early-postmark exception applies to domestic registered express mail. [s1] [s2]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
AFLSP April 2027: 4-13 November 2026, closes 17:00 JST. October 2027 guide expected around January 2027
and applications around April 2027, both tentative. MEXT embassy initial dates depend on nationality; central
2027 provisional-acceptance request deadline was 1 September 2026. No 2027 general
university-recommended MEXT recruitment. Fall 2027 tuition-waiver dates not published. [s9] [s14] [s17] [s19]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
Ordinary master’s checklist does not request academic letters. AFLSP references due with complete
scholarship packet by 13 November 2026 17:00 JST. MEXT references follow embassy deadline. Exceptional
eligibility route 9 required its sealed faculty letter by 15 May 2026 17:00; normal UChicago degree route does
not use that category. [s2] [s9] [s14]
Test-score receipt [2027 confirmed]
Math/RIMS take an English entrance paper on 18 August 2026, 16:45-17:00; do not apply other Science
divisions’ TOEFL/TOEIC submission rules. AFLSP English proof/evaluation due with the 13 November 2026
packet. No GRE delivery deadline found. [s2] [s9] [s13]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
All admission papers due 26 June 2026 17:00. Pay screening fee 8-26 June; submit contact Google form 8 June
09:00-26 June 17:00. Written mathematics/English exams 18 August; orals 20-22 August (23 August reserve);
results 28 August noon. AAO precedes the application period. [s2] [s6]

Admission/enrollment schedule comes with the admission notice; detailed instructions in late February 2027. A
single public acceptance deadline was not established. For AFLSP, results are expected around January 2027,
but acceptance deadline not publicly specified. [s2] [s9]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Math/RIMS regular admission includes its own English examination. Science master’s is not an English-taught
program; Math says sufficient Japanese for courses/life is needed although exam questions have English
versions. Forms may be completed in English. AFLSP separately expects TOEFL iBT 90/4.5 or IELTS 6.5-level
English, with alternative evidence permitted. [s4] [s5] [s10]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
No UChicago-degree waiver of Math’s English entrance exam verified. AFLSP accepts proof of an English-taught
bachelor’s; the English Evaluation Form explicitly permits completed or expected English-medium degrees and
requires an evaluator’s ratings/signature even for native speakers. UChicago evidence must be supplied; F-1 is
not proof. [s2] [s10] [s13]

GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No GRE listed for Math/RIMS in the ordinary application/exam instructions. They conduct their own written/oral
selection. Whether unsolicited GRE scores would be accepted or ignored is not established; no requirement
should be inferred. [s2] [s4]

upload for every applicable university degree. Formal admission: original official transcript/degree evidence,

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [2027 confirmed]
Ordinary Math/RIMS master’s checklist: no academic recommendation letter specified. Exceptional early-entry
eligibility category 9: one sealed faculty letter. AAO’s published general document list also contains no
academic recommendation. Scholarships have separate requirements below. [s2] [s7]
Scholarship references [2027 confirmed]
AFLSP: at least one prescribed-form recommendation from supervisor/equivalent; prospective Kyoto adviser
preferred, otherwise current/recent university faculty. Additional letters optional, not duplicates from one
author. MEXT: president/dean/adviser letter plus employer letter if employed; sample assesses relationship,
development, collaboration, leadership, confidence, character and graduate potential. AFLSP form-specific
questions still require checking.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: The current-linked AFLSP recommendation form asks for applicant
name; referee name, affiliation, position and email; free recommendation text; date and signature. It requires
English or an English translation. No distinct rating questionnaire or explicit word/page cap was found in this
template. [s10] [s11] [s14] [s16] [js24k]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Ordinary admission is postal; no automated referee invitation workflow found. AFLSP applicant emails the
complete ZIP, including recommendations; no automatic invitation described. MEXT sample uses a signed
sealed envelope returned to the applicant. [s2] [s9] [s16]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
No after-submission letter invitations described. AFLSP references belong in the complete scholarship packet
before deadline; MEXT uses embassy procedures. [s9] [s10] [s16]
Receipt confirmation [2027 confirmed]
Kyoto explicitly declines mailed-admission arrival enquiries: use carrier tracking. AAO sends submission and

processing emails; contact Google form emails a response copy. AFLSP acknowledges the complete application
by email within two working days; no individual-letter dashboard verified. [s2] [s6] [s10]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Formal admission generally disallows changes after receipt and does not return papers. AFLSP letters must use
its form; no permission for post-deadline replacement or reuse was verified. AAO may request corrections and
resubmission for incomplete files. [s2] [s6] [s10]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required formal application includes the prescribed curriculum-vitae/history form, printed on A4; no separate
free-format academic CV requirement found. AFLSP application contains education, activities and work-history
fields. Limits are supplied boxes unless a current replacement template says otherwise. [s3] [s12]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
AAO requires SOP including research plan. Optional template paraphrase: personal context, motivation for
supervisor/Kyoto graduate study, previous study/research, proposed research, career plans; Japanese/English,
upload. Template contains provided space but no numerical word/page limit. School admission separately
requires the Math or RIMS report; AAO does not replace it. [s6] [s7] [s8] [s3]
Personal / background statement [Conflict]
AAO SOP includes personal context within its broader statement, not a verified independent background essay.
Linked AFLSP form has an optional ≤300-word memorable-life-experience response; its 2026 cohort label
conflicts with current 2027 page, so confirm replacement/version before drafting. [s8] [s12] [s9]
Research-interest statement [2027 confirmed]
Department questionnaire: up to three distinct subfields, first required; optional precise subject/adviser names.
RIMS questionnaire similarly permits up to three fields and multiple desired faculty, then asks intended
research topics. Complete prescribed forms without resizing boxes; type or use clear black ink. [s3]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Department report: study/research plan covering preferred subfields, ≤3 A4 pages total; begin with keywords
and include specified Japanese report label/name and page numbering. AAO additionally requires research
proposal within SOP. AFLSP separate research plan has free format/no stated cap: paraphrase
rationale/background, relation to bachelor’s work, aims, methods and expected outcomes. [s3] [s8] [s10]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [2027 confirmed]
RIMS: report ≥1 page, no published upper cap, A4 preferred, 20-mm side margins, prescribed cover.
Paraphrase - explain a memorable theory/theorem, a problem investigated, or original program; outline,
appeal and key argument. If long, add one-page summary. Department route uses study/research-plan report
instead. Papers are submitted documents, not substituted by links. [s3]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate required publications list or arbitrary-paper upload identified in normal Math/RIMS checklist. MEXT
asks thesis abstracts if theses exist, not automatic full-paper submission. Any optional additional portfolio
should be cleared with admissions. [s2] [s14]
Course-list document [2027 confirmed]
Department asks seminar adviser/textbook and books/papers studied intensively. RIMS asks seminar text,
author/title/chapters of research-field texts, other advanced reading and interesting courses/topics. These are
prescribed questionnaire responses; no additional all-math-course inventory or independent word cap
identified. [s3]
Scholarship essays [Conflict]
AFLSP: separate ≤2 A4-page contemporary-Asia problem essay, proposal for leaders’ response; English typed

PDF. Linked application adds three ≤300-word answers (motivation/career; East-Asian issue/realistic
intervention; leadership example), optional personal memory ≤300 words, and ≤3-minute video
introduction/motivation/aspirations/surprising trait. Paste accessible non-password video link. Form says 2026
cohort: verify current version; do not assume separate essay duplicates replace it. MEXT research plan ≤2
pages plus optional attachments, typed/block letters. [s10] [s12] [s15]
Other short answers / materials [2027 confirmed]
Formal admission: prescribed photo/exam-ticket forms, three 4.5×3.5-cm photos within three months, fee
proof and signed checklist/pledge. AFLSP additionally requires photo JPEG (guideline’s specific exception to
general PDF instruction), English evidence, declaration, admission letter and applicable
residence-card/Chinese-degree verification; all files in one emailed ZIP. [s2] [s9] [s10]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
No guaranteed master’s/doctoral department annual stipend established. AFLSP April 2027: approximately JPY
150,000-220,000/month plus reimbursement of JPY 535,800 annual tuition and JPY 282,000 admission.
Twelve-month arithmetic: JPY 1.8-2.64 million living stipend, exchange-rate dependent. MEXT 2027
master’s/PhD: JPY 144,000/145,000 monthly, plus Kyoto City’s published JPY 3,000 regional supplement;
tuition/exam/admission waiver and conditional travel. [s10] [s14] [s17]
Years of support [Standing rule]
AFLSP at most two years, no extension; second year subject to review. MEXT regular degree covers standard
period, with competitive extension for progression. Science advertises TA/RA support for doctoral D1-D3, not a
quantified master’s guarantee. [s10] [s14] [s20]
International eligibility [2027 confirmed]
AFLSP requires one of its listed Asian citizenships, under 35, Japanese Student status; Japanese dual nationals
excluded. F-1 reveals none of this. UChicago is not a designated pre-admission institution: applicant must
already have passed the relevant Kyoto entrance examination for the ordinary AFLSP eligibility route. MEXT
has separate nationality/birth-date rules. [s10] [s14]
Conditions and duties [2027 confirmed]
AFLSP requires financial need, academic merit, full-time enrollment, reports/exchange activities and summer
program; normally no outside funding or employment, TA/RA possible only after consultation. Monthly
enrollment confirmation precedes payment. Tuition/admission are reimbursed after receipts, so upfront funds
matter. MEXT has its own progress/attendance/status restrictions. [s10] [s14]
Extra funding application [2027 confirmed]
AFLSP and embassy-MEXT require separate applications; AAO is neither admission nor scholarship application.
Kyoto Science will not recruit for 2027 general university-recommended MEXT. AFLSP scholarship/admission
decisions are independent; only one Kyoto-handled scholarship application at a time under its FAQ. [s6] [s5] [s11]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
JASSO privately-financed international award: JPY 48,000/month as of April 2026, university nomination and
competitive. Private scholarships vary; many arise after enrollment and prohibit overlapping
applications/awards. Science doctoral TA/RA excludes JSPS-DC and MEXT recipients; division determines
hiring/rate. Merit/need tuition and admission-fee exemptions are separate competitive processes. [s21] [s20]
[s19]
Application fee [Standing rule]
Screening fee JPY 30,000; payment via Kyoto system (credit cards usable from overseas; domestic alternatives
available). Admission JPY 282,000 and tuition JPY 535,800/year, subject to change; admission due at
registration, tuition normally May/November. [s2] [s18]

Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Screening-fee exception: designated-disaster cases contacted office by 1 June 2026; MEXT exemption/refund
depends on award/enrollment status. No general overseas need-based screening waiver verified.
Admission/tuition exemptions: graduate students may apply based on merit/need; international applicants
treated as their own financial supporter. Separate pre-application plus EOAS/documents, 2027 dates
unresolved. [s2] [s19]

MEXT has separate nationality/birth-date rules. [s10] [s14]

fields.label: Conditions and duties
fields.text: AFLSP requires financial need, academic merit, full-time enrollment, reports/exchange activities and summer program; normally no outside funding or employment, TA/RA possible only after consultation. Monthly enrollment confirmation precedes payment. Tuition/admission are reimbursed after receipts, so upfront funds matter. MEXT has its own progress/attendance/status restrictions. [s10] [s14]

fields.label: Extra funding application
fields.text: AFLSP and embassy-MEXT require separate applications; AAO is neither admission nor scholarship application. Kyoto Science will not recruit for 2027 general university-recommended MEXT. AFLSP scholarship/admission decisions are independent; only one Kyoto-handled scholarship application at a time under its FAQ. [s6] [s5] [s11]

fields.label: Other funding routes
fields.text: JASSO privately-financed international award: JPY 48,000/month as of April 2026, university nomination and competitive. Private scholarships vary; many arise after enrollment and prohibit overlapping applications/awards. Science doctoral TA/RA excludes JSPS-DC and MEXT recipients; division determines hiring/rate. Merit/need tuition and admission-fee exemptions are separate competitive processes. [s21] [s20] [s19]

fields.label: Application fee
fields.text: Screening fee JPY 30,000; payment via Kyoto system (credit cards usable from overseas; domestic alternatives available). Admission JPY 282,000 and tuition JPY 535,800/year, subject to change; admission due at registration, tuition normally May/November. [s2] [s18]

fields.label: Fee waiver
fields.text: Screening-fee exception: designated-disaster cases contacted office by 1 June 2026; MEXT exemption/refund depends on award/enrollment status. No general overseas need-based screening waiver verified. Admission/tuition exemptions: graduate students may apply based on merit/need; international applicants treated as their own financial supporter. Separate pre-application plus EOAS/documents, 2027 dates unresolved. [s2] [s19]

Pay attention to
• Department Mathematics and RIMS Mathematical Sciences are distinct tracks; applicants may select both but
need their different questionnaires/reports and possibly separate orals.
• April 2027 admission is already closed and requires degree by March 2027; the next guide must be checked
for October 2027.
• AAO introduces a separate SOP/research-plan stage, before the academic application.
• AFLSP has citizenship and prior-admission restrictions plus a stale linked form; receiving scholarship does not
itself confer admission.
• Tomoyuki Arakawa moved to OIST and became Kyoto professor emeritus in April 2026; do not rely on an
older RIMS listing for 2027 supervision. Official OIST profile
https://www.oist.jp/research/research-units/chiral/tomoyuki-arakawa.

RIMS selection before applying.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
UChicago bachelor’s normally qualifies for a master’s if complete before matriculation; a master’s or
equivalent normally precedes the three-year PhD. April 2027 requires degree by 31 March 2027, so June 2027
graduation misses it. October 2027 remains a possible future route requiring next-year instructions, not the
closed booklet’s October 2026 option. [s5] [s2]

account, academic documents and SOP/research plan; it is separate from admission and funding. Identify a
supervisor, await AAO permission where applicable, then contact them. Regular entrance exams require travel
to Kyoto and a suitable visa; US F-1 is insufficient for Japan. [s6] [s7] [s5]

Complete AAO first where instructed; its contact permission is not admission. RIMS recommends
prospective-supervisor contact before formal application. Math questionnaire can name advisers without an
established acceptance commitment. Confirm October 2027 supervision and exam language before planning
travel.

among advisers; do not infer ineligibility merely from rank. Program-specific/Hakubi appointments Kakuhama
and Shimada were absent from the checked guide, so independent supervision is unresolved. [s6] [s22] [s3]

Kyoto University
Japan · Graduate School of Science: Mathematics and Mathematical Sciences master’s (Department / RIMS tracks), then

Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written

Pay attention to
• Department Mathematics and RIMS Mathematical Sciences are distinct tracks; applicants may select both but
need their different questionnaires/reports and possibly separate orals.
• April 2027 admission is already closed and requires degree by March 2027; the next guide must be checked
for October 2027.
• AAO introduces a separate SOP/research-plan stage, before the academic application.
• AFLSP has citizenship and prior-admission restrictions plus a stale linked form; receiving scholarship does not
itself confer admission.
• Tomoyuki Arakawa moved to OIST and became Kyoto professor emeritus in April 2026; do not rely on an
older RIMS listing for 2027 supervision. Official OIST profile
https://www.oist.jp/research/research-units/chiral/tomoyuki-arakawa.
• Faculty listing does not guarantee capacity or acceptance; check supervisor consent and Mathematics versus
RIMS selection before applying.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
UChicago bachelor’s normally qualifies for a master’s if complete before matriculation; a master’s or
equivalent normally precedes the three-year PhD. April 2027 requires degree by 31 March 2027, so June 2027
graduation misses it. October 2027 remains a possible future route requiring next-year instructions, not the
closed booklet’s October 2026 option. [s5] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Complete AAO before the school’s application period; start 2-3 months before the deadline. AAO requires an
account, academic documents and SOP/research plan; it is separate from admission and funding. Identify a
supervisor, await AAO permission where applicable, then contact them. Regular entrance exams require travel
to Kyoto and a suitable visa; US F-1 is insufficient for Japan. [s6] [s7] [s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Complete AAO first where instructed; its contact permission is not admission. RIMS recommends
prospective-supervisor contact before formal application. Math questionnaire can name advisers without an
established acceptance commitment. Confirm October 2027 supervision and exam language before planning
travel.
Additional programme-specific evidence [C]: The 2027 Mathematics guide lists some assistant professors
among advisers; do not infer ineligibility merely from rank. Program-specific/Hakubi appointments Kakuhama
and Shimada were absent from the checked guide, so independent supervision is unresolved. [s6] [s22] [s3]

AFLSP April 2027: 4-13 November 2026, closes 17:00 JST. October 2027 guide expected around January 2027
